eligibility_guard: Aggregate PASS plus check 13 NOT_EVALUABLE solely because selection is pending, no existing selection/application; an existing Decision moves assessment to later phases. Aggregate counts are not counts of admission-ready subjects.
empty_scope_disposition: Empty aggregation is vacuously PASS but establishes no substantive readiness. Actual selected pre-decision set is the pinned nonempty 12 checks; selecting an empty readiness set is out of this profile contract.
limits: No arbitrary/infinite check universe, temporal trace correctness, owner authentication or actual applied effect claimed.
